data.name: Novotel Annecy Centre
data.hotelDescription:
Modern Comfort and Convenience
Novotel Annecy Centre Atria offers a perfect blend of modern comfort and convenience. The soundproofed and air-conditioned rooms, equipped with amenities like a flat-screen TV, minibar, and free WiFi, ensure a relaxing stay.

Dining Delights
Indulge in a delightful culinary experience at The Craic, the in-house restaurant offering European and French dishes. Start your day with a buffet breakfast and unwind with a drink and light snacks at the hotel bar.

Family-Friendly Amenities
For families, the hotel features an indoor play area and a library for children. Additionally, bike rental is available for exploring the charming surroundings of Annecy.

Book now to experience the perfect combination of comfort, culinary delights, and family-friendly amenities at Novotel Annecy Centre Atria.

categories.name: Cleanliness
categories.description: Generally reported as clean and well kept (clean rooms and good breakfast area), with a few mentions of an unpleasant smell in one room.

categories.name: Service
categories.description: Multiple reviews praise attentive, friendly and helpful staff (reception and breakfast team); staff responsiveness and care were frequent positives.

categories.name: Location
categories.description: Consistently highlighted as an excellent, central location (next to the train station and close to attractions); several guests noted convenient access despite occasional train noise.

categories.name: Room Quality
categories.description: Mixed comments: comfortable beds and decent decor for many, but several guests found rooms small/cramped, with awkward layouts (separate toilet) and some felt rooms were underwhelming for the price.

categories.name: Amenities
categories.description: Good on-site food & bar and baggage service; parking is available but the garage entrance is narrow and parking is described as expensive; no gym and minimal in-room minibar noted.

categories.name: Value for Money
categories.description: Mixed to negative: some guests felt the room or charges (deposit, expensive parking) were not worth the price, while others found the price-performance reasonable.

categories.name: Food and Beverage
categories.description: Strong positives for breakfast (varied, excellent) and the on-site bar/restaurant; specific praise for food quality (notably a highly rated burger).

categories.name: Overall Experience
categories.description: Overall favourable stay for most guests due to location, staff and breakfast; issues such as train noise, narrow parking and occasional booking/cancellation problems lowered some experiences.
